title: ID0418399-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R6 313033014001] Connector issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
This is the second ticket in less than 5 days regarding the Sicharge D charging
station serial number R6 313033014001.
The connector previously reported is once again faulty.
Observed issues:
* The green light strip on the right side is no longer working.
* An LED remains active on the right-hand meter, unlike the one on the left.
* The connector is still operational and available for charging.
Please investigate this new incident and suggest a sustainable corrective
action.
